camel_example: aliyun emr CreateApiTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --ApiName CreateCluster --Content content --TemplateName DATALAKE_template --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates a predefined API operation template. The template contains information about an API operation, including the basic structure, request method, URL path, request parameters, and response format
description_zh: 创建一个预定义的API模板，该模板包含了API的基本结构、请求方式、URL路径、请求参数和响应格式等信息
kebab_example: aliyun emr create-api-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-name DATALAKE_template --api-name CreateCluster --content content --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApiTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the API operation. You can create only a cluster API operation template. Set the value to CreateCluster
parameters.help_zh: API名称，目前只支持创建集群API模板。取值范围：CreateCluster
parameters.name: api_name

parameters.help_en: The content of the cluster API operation template. Set the value to JSON strings of the request parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454393.html API operation for creating a cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群模版内容。取值：创建集群https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454393.html的入参JSON化后的内容
parameters.name: content

TemplateId.description_en: Template ID (it is recommended to use the parameter TemplateId)
